_comment: Regex patterns for links the dead-link checker should ignore. Tuned from a full-site sweep. Only false positives belong here: documentation placeholder/example URLs, and hosts that block crawlers (return 403/408/429 to bots but resolve fine in a browser). The ',https?://' pattern skips Docusaurus-generated 'article:author' meta tags, which join multiple author profile URLs with a comma into a single value the crawler misreads as one URL. Do NOT add hosts that genuinely 404 - those are real dead links worth fixing. Merged with the built-in defaults in scripts/check-dead-links.mjs.
